clause: CSI-MeasConfig; CSI-ResourceConfig; CSI-ReportConfig; SRS-Config; PUCCH-Config; PDSCH-Config; PUSCH-Config
requirement_summary: UE Phase 6 CSI/SRS/TRS/PTRS/codebook configuration must come from decoded RRC after dedicated activation, not YAML or MATLAB runtime objects.
independent_reference: 3GPP TS 38.331 official archive; independent ASN.1 decode readback

requirement_summary: NZP CSI-RS, ZP CSI-RS, CSI-IM, resource sets, periodicity, density, CDM, ports, and collision masks must be resolved explicitly and mapped to the live carrier grid.
independent_reference: MATLAB 5G Toolbox nrCSIRS/nrCSIRSIndices and independent RE-count checks

requirement_summary: UE CSI-RS measurements must be extracted from received waveform samples after channel/RF application, with NMSE only as post-run scoring.
independent_reference: MATLAB 5G Toolbox reference plus analytically constructed channel cases

clause: CSI report quantities; Type-I codebook; CQI tables
requirement_summary: CRI, RI, PMI, and CQI must be selected from measured CSI-RS evidence with complete candidate and rejection lineage; selection algorithm is implementation-specific, not a mandated 3GPP algorithm.

clause: PUCCH format 2; UCI coding; PUCCH resource selection
table: PUCCH Format 2 and UCI coding rules
requirement_summary: CSI reports must be bit-packed, capacity-checked without truncation, encoded, transmitted over real PUCCH Format 2 waveform, and decoded at the gNB before scheduler use.
SRS resources, ports, comb, cyclic shifts, hopping, triggers, and power control must be resolved from decoded configuration and mapped to live UL waveform resources.
independent_reference: MATLAB 5G Toolbox nrSRS/nrSRSIndices and independent frequency/comb checks

clause: SRS measurements and UL channel acquisition
requirement_summary: The gNB must estimate UL channel, SRS RSRP/SINR, rank, and TPMI from received SRS without true-channel or expected-answer inputs.
independent_reference: no-oracle negative tests and analytically constructed channels

requirement_summary: TDD reciprocity must be explicit, calibrated, age-stamped, and labeled IDEAL_RECIPROCITY_CALIBRATION if ideal calibration is selected.
independent_reference: independent calibration residual calculation and stale-channel tests

clause: tracking reference signal resources and measurements
requirement_summary: TRS must use received tracking-reference resources to estimate residual CFO, timing, sampling, and common phase, with before/after evidence when impairments are enabled.
independent_reference: corrupted/no-signal negative tests and independent offset injectors

clause: PDSCH PTRS; PUSCH PTRS; PTRS density
table: PTRS density and RE mapping tables
requirement_summary: PTRS must be associated with actual PDSCH/PUSCH transmissions and receiver phase correction must be waveform-derived with before/after EVM evidence.
independent_reference: MATLAB 5G Toolbox PTRS primitives and independent CPE injectors

clause: layer mapping; codeword mapping; PDSCH layers and antenna ports
requirement_summary: Rank-2 PDSCH requires measured rank eligibility, two live layers, valid DM-RS ports, total-power preservation, per-layer SINR, and decode evidence.
independent_reference: deterministic rank-2 channels and independent singular-value references

clause: PUSCH layers; PUSCH codebook transmission; TPMI
requirement_summary: Rank-2 PUSCH requires SRS-based rank/TPMI, decoded DCI 0_1, two live layers, valid DM-RS, total-power preservation, and gNB decode evidence.
independent_reference: deterministic rank-2 UL channels and independent TPMI checks

clause: multi-user PDSCH resources; DM-RS ports; precoding policy
requirement_summary: DL MU-MIMO requires overlapping PRBs and symbols, distinct user streams, compatible DM-RS, measured-CSI precoding, per-user interference evidence, and independent decode/HARQ evidence.
independent_reference: orthogonal/aligned channel fixtures and independent leakage metrics

clause: multi-user PUSCH resources; DM-RS resources; joint receiver
requirement_summary: UL MU-MIMO requires same PRBs/symbols, orthogonal DM-RS, joint channel estimation, joint detector, per-user LLR/CRC evidence, and independent HARQ state.
Increasing rank or scheduling two MU users must not silently double total configured transmit power.
Production CSI, SRS, rank, PMI, beam, precoder, and MU decisions must not consume true channel tensors, expected answers, or UE private measurement state.
independent_reference: negative corruption tests and source-map audit

requirement_summary: Phase6Ok is true only when all Phase 6 evidence gates and Phase5Ok are true, and Phase6Ok must not be promoted to full scenario ResultOk.
